text: Allah fodii on, onon muumini'en, konu-heyri ɗuuɗundi ndi henndotoɗon ka udditoyton liislaamu woo, O yaccinani on konu-hoyri ndin Khaybara, O haɗi juuɗe Alyahuuda'en hewtugol ɓeynguureeji mon ɗin ɓaawo mon, fewndo ɓe himmirnoo ɗum, haray ko no ɗin konu-hoyriiji yaccinaaɗi wonirana on maande ko Allah wallata on kon O semmbina on, O fewnira on kadi e laawol focciingol, ngol ooñaaki.
